description:
Ukrainian legal entities in the open ЄДР extract (Єдиний державний реєстр
юридичних осіб). Legal entities only; ФОП are `search_fop`.

The open extract publishes neither the registered address (місцезнаходження)
nor КВЕД activity codes. Both were withdrawn upstream for security reasons, so
they are absent rather than lost and no response can supply them; only a paid
НАІС/Дія extract carries them.

`q` does not reach officers or founders. `lookup` returns those.

q.description: Free text over the ЄДРПОУ code and the names.
